adjudication.rationale: In this diff, `Admin::GroupsController#create` no longer reads any `usernames` input (it only uses `params[:name]` and `params[:visible]`), so a client sending a stale/extra `usernames` param would currently be ignored. The updated specs under `context ".create"` only verify whitespace stripping on `name` and do not assert that providing `usernames` during create has no effect (e.g., does not add members / does not error). This is a specific, diff-grounded missing-test concern rather than a demonstrated defect.
